verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Mercury lets users revoke API/MCP access from the dashboard (mercury-docs-25), but there is no evidence of any data retention policy, data export, or data deletion controls for account/transaction data processed by AI agents or MCP tools. Missing for 10: documented retention periods, a deletion/export mechanism for stored financial/AI-interaction data, and any privacy-policy statement on how long data used by AI tools is kept.
